description: List every company and CAEN activity your API key watches, each with what changed since the last poll_watchlist, most severe first. A peek: nothing is marked as seen (poll_watchlist does that). Free and never counted as a lookup, also with 0 left today.
name: list_watches

outputSchema.description: Every watch you hold, with what changed since the last poll (nothing marked seen).

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

limits.description: plan, enforced, max (the plan's watchlist size), used.

owner.description: Whose watches these are (key prefix or IP).

watches.description: Per watch: kind (company or caen), target (CUI or code), county, createdAt, lastSeenAt, name (a company) or since (a code), severity (0 = no change) and change (what changed, or null).

title: List my watches
